BiblicalUsage: Azaz was the father of Bela, a Reubenite chief whose sons dwelt in Aroer and eastward to the entering in of the wilderness. He appears once, in the genealogy of Reuben, as the head of a family that held the eastern border.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the genealogies keep men like Azaz because every family on the border mattered to God, even the ones the story never comes back to.
